channel.title: Revive
channel.description: Updates for Revive, the free and open source Mac cleaner.

item.title: Revive 0.4.1
item.description:
What's new

  • Automatic updates: Revive checks for a new version at launch and every hour, and installs it in one click when you agree (Settings › Updates, or Revive › Check for Updates…).
  • Permissions kept across updates: releases are now signed with a stable certificate, so macOS keeps Full Disk Access from one version to the next.
  • French translations for the new settings.

Installing

Coming from 0.4.0? Download this version once by hand; later versions arrive automatically.

On first launch, macOS asks to confirm: System Settings › Privacy & Security › Open Anyway.
